new_result.name: QFORM-ALGEBRAIC-GENERICIZATION-NO-LOSS-v1
new_result.statement: For any finite family of nonzero polynomial nondegeneracy conditions on Sym_n, the optimal full QFORM height constant equals the optimal constant restricted to compactly supported smooth cap-one product inputs and target matrices on the simultaneous nonvanishing locus.
new_result.decisive_inequality: P(X^T A X in I) <= P(X^T B_k X in I^(delta_k R_X)) <= C_gen (|I|+2 delta_k R_X), with B_k generic target and delta_k->0.
new_result.consequence: Exact algebraic degeneracies may be removed at no loss of the universal constant; quantitative near-degeneracy remains essential.

regularity_control.statement: Rank two can have bounded density without any continuous representative: for iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], X_1^2+X_2^2 has density pi on (0,1/4) and zero on (-infinity,0).

unresolved_implication: Prove one matrix- and dimension-independent height estimate on the generic smooth-input locus, uniform as every pivot/minor/transversality quantity approaches zero; grouped-coordinate or ridge aggregation must eliminate reciprocal near-degeneracy costs before closure.
next_step: Apply the closure lemma in proof assembly so exact zero pivots are not treated as a separate branch; attack the near-zero uniform estimate on the generic locus.
